message: ボインの記憶

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」
Sengen'in-sensei's strictness far exceeded expectations.

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-That was a brutal class.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Calling on me for a problem using a formula we haven't even learned yet is so mean--」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we learned that a long time ago.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You traitor, Synn-kun! Thanks to that, I'm stuck with a mountain of homework--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I remembered that formula, though...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even my best friend betrayed me--」

name: Eddie
message: 「Making someone stand out in the hall? That's unheard of these days.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's tyranny--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you guys are just hopeless.」
Could it be...
It's not that the teacher is brutal, it's just that my friends are too hopeless?

name: Misa
message: 「Sengen'in-sensei? It was a wonderful class.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」
Plus one point to the 'my friends are hopeless' theory.

name: Misa
message: 「A classroom brimming with tension, quiet enough to hear a pin drop. Strict yet easy-to-follow instruction. High erudition, answering any question without faltering.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now that is a true class! That is how a teacher ought to be!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your eyes must be knotholes, Vice President. That was a terrible class. I didn't understand the formulas at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Same level as Sacchin.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer! You just casually said something awful!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. It's Sengen'in-sensei's first time, so she's just eager to do well. She'll mellow out before long.」

name: Synn
message: 「When I hear 'student teacher'... I usually picture someone who tries hard at everything and spins their wheels a bit, which makes them kinda endearing, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And their unfamiliar suit doesn't quite fit right, yeah?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And she was always tripping, and you loved the way she pushed up her slipping glasses every time, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Her hair was a little wavy and had a slight reddish tint, so the guidance counselor Godzilla used to lecture her about it. Even though she was a teacher.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah, that's right... Brings back memories...」

name: Misa
message: 「That's awfully specific, isn't it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Well, she was a student teacher who came to our elementary school, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ms. Hazuki... I wonder if she became a great teacher...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She was Synn's first love, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--?! No, she wasn't!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehe. Don't be shy, don't be shy. It happened when we were little kids.」
My first love wasn't Ms. Hazuki.
My first love was...

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what they call a forbidden romance between student and teacher, isn't it. How exciting.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Leave it to Synn-sama. Never slacking on researching older women for his world harem plan.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How indecent!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'O-Oh, ma'am!' 'You mustn't, Mr. Rice Dealer!' 'I can't hold back anymooore!'--apparently, that's the standard exchange for this kind of thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「Um... standard exchange for what, I wonder?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nah, he just admired her and got all starry-eyed over her.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. You've been spacey and indecisive ever since you were little, haven't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you expect me to do about it?」

name: Ria
message: 「What did you like about that teacher, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... how should I put it... I guess how kind she was...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That teacher sure had huge boobs.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to bring that part up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, come on, Synn, remember that time you bumped into her in the hallway, buried your face right in her chest, and got a nosebleed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah, waaah, waaah, waaah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bigger than even Ria-chan's!?」

name: Ria
message: 「G-geez, Paa-chan!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Once Senpai reaches that age, she'll surpass her, I think.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait a second, Synn, you've been a boob guy ever since back then!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr... No, wait, should I have been drinking milk after all?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, so the President's number one target really is Senpai, isn't it.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, that's really how it ends up, huh... This is bad, at this rate...」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that true, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, um...\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He won't even flatly deny it...」

name: Sally
message: 「He says Misa-Misa's out because her boobs are smaller than Ria's.」

name: Misa
message: 「Fine by me. Judging a woman by the size of her chest! Sakura-kun, you're the worst!」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't said a single word!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, the Treasurer was out of the running from the very start.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nana!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?! I'm definitely not out of the running!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The gap in firepower is obvious, soba.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kyuu.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-hey, mine have gotten bigger than they used to be too! Right, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't throw this on me!」

name: Misa
message: 「So you really can only look at women with those kinds of eyes. How shameless.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well... it's a fact that they've gotten bigger compared to before, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, my childhood friend is backing me up here, so they really have gotten bigger!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if they've gotten bigger, you're still no match for Senpai.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... Fair point...」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, you know, having big boobs isn't really a good thing, okay? My shoulders get stiff, and people give me weird looks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Spoken like a true winner...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But hey, Nanaka has plenty of great qualities too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Like what?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh... You're really good at making soba noodles!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, in a situation like this... that's kinda off the mark...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pfft, hehe... Well, whatever. That's so like you, Synn.」
Nanaka has lots of great qualities.
Saying them out loud, though, was just way too embarrassing.
